I found 12 functions and methods that call `SpawnMeta::new_unnamed` directly, all in the `tokio` crate. `tokio-util`, `tokio-stream`, `tokio-test` and `tokio-macros` never call it. I searched the whole workspace for `new_unnamed` and checked which function contains each match. Apart from the definition in `tokio/src/util/trace.rs`, every match is in the list below.

**`tokio/src/runtime/blocking/pool.rs`**
- `Spawner.spawn_blocking` (lines 308, 315)
- `Spawner.spawn_mandatory_blocking` (lines 346, 353), which only exists when the `fs` feature is enabled

**`tokio/src/runtime/local_runtime/runtime.rs`**
- `LocalRuntime.spawn_local` (line 153)
- `LocalRuntime.block_on` (line 220)

**`tokio/src/runtime/handle.rs`**
- `Handle.spawn` (lines 195, 197)
- `Handle.block_on` (lines 303, 305)

**`tokio/src/runtime/runtime.rs`**
- `Runtime.spawn` (lines 250, 253)
- `Runtime.block_on` (lines 340, 342)

**`tokio/src/task/spawn.rs`**
- free function `spawn` (lines 173, 175)

**`tokio/src/task/local.rs`**
- free function `spawn_local` (lines 375, 377)
- `LocalSet.spawn_local` (lines 571, 573)

Most of these call it twice: once when the future or closure is large enough to be boxed, and once when it isn't.
